entries.29519cd23dad84b4: This is the reporting segment that carries out home extensions and renovations, replacement and repair of residential equipment, and renovation of buildings. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,940 million. One division of the company carries out residential renovation and building renewal, and consolidated subsidiary BX Yutaka Form Co., Ltd. carries out residential renovation.
entries.418e5cd812dd5d08: This is a reportable segment that manufactures and sells shutters for factories and warehouses, shutters for stores, and residential garage shutters. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥94,193 million. In addition to the company, consolidated subsidiary BX Tempal Co., Ltd. and subsidiaries in Vietnam, Australia and New Zealand also manufacture and sell these products, and parts such as opening and closing devices are manufactured and sold by consolidated subsidiary BX Shinsei Seiki Co., Ltd.

entries.8f2189ac8146fd5e: This is the reporting segment that performs maintenance, inspection and repair of existing shutters and building materials. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥32,596 million. The company and its consolidated subsidiary Bunka Shutter Service Co., Ltd. handle the work, providing emergency repair response and scheduled maintenance.

entries.c788e133b942e2c0: This is a business category that is not included in the reporting segments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,040 million. It includes the Water Shutoff Business, which handles flood-prevention equipment; the Heat Shielding Business, which handles indoor heat-shielding sheets and similar products; the solar power generation system business; the real estate leasing business; and, through consolidated subsidiaries, BX Aiwa Co., Ltd., which operates as a non-life insurance agency and travel agency, and BX TOSHO Co., Ltd., which provides architectural design services.
entries.cd09b5d7d5d5b5fc: This is a reportable segment that manufactures and sells steel doors for buildings and condominiums, partitions for schools, and residential doors and exterior products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥93,511 million. Residential building materials are manufactured by consolidated subsidiaries including BX Nishiyama Tekko Co., Ltd., BX Kaneshin Co., Ltd. and Ecowood Co., Ltd., and building materials for buildings are manufactured by consolidated subsidiaries including BX Routes Co., Ltd., BX Tiaru Co., Ltd., BX Koun Co., Ltd. and BX Asahi Kenzai Co., Ltd.; the company purchases some of them and sells them. The equity-method affiliate Fuji Sash Co., Ltd. group also manufactures and sells these products.
